result.stdout:
Usage:
  msieve capabilities
  msieve list
  msieve get <script-name> [--output <file>]
  msieve check --file <file>
  msieve put <script-name> --file <file> [--activate]
  msieve activate <script-name>
  msieve deactivate
  msieve delete <script-name>

ManageSieve options:
  --sieve-host <host>          Override TRANSIEVER_SIEVE_HOST.
  --sieve-port <port>          Override TRANSIEVER_SIEVE_PORT.
  --sieve-username <name>      Override TRANSIEVER_SIEVE_USERNAME.
  --sieve-password <value>     Override TRANSIEVER_SIEVE_PASSWORD.
  --sieve-security-mode <mode> Override TRANSIEVER_SIEVE_SECURITY_MODE.
  -h, --help                   Show this help.

The default security mode is StartTlsRequired on port 4190.
Plaintext authentication is refused.
